item.title: Economic Survey 2025–26: UPI powers credit growth as digital payments drive financial inclusion
item.description: India’s Economic Survey 2025–26 highlights UPI’s growing role in expanding credit access and deepening financial inclusion, especially in smaller towns. UPI hit record highs in December 2025 with 21.6 billion transactions worth Rs 28 lakh crore, reinforcing its dominance in digital payments.

item.title: Delhi govt clears first corridor of elevated ring road project to ease traffic snarls
item.description: The Delhi government has approved the first 5km stretch of the proposed Elevated Ring Road, marking the start of a six-phase project aimed at easing congestion on some of the city’s busiest arterial roads.

item.title: T20 World Cup: Sri Lanka to deploy elite armed forces with a focus on India-Pakistan battle
item.description: Sri Lanka is set to deploy a unit of elite armed forces for the players and teams travelling to their nation for the T20 World Cup 2026, especially with an eye on the India vs Pakistan battle.

item.title: 90s Indie feels are back: Bosco Leslie Martis launches BLM Music with star-studded Pardes
item.description: Renowned choreographer Bosco Leslie Martis launches BLM Music with Pardes, a 90s indie-inspired banger starring Aniara Gupta and more. “Music has always been deeply personal to me,” says Bosco, aiming to nurture fresh talent.

item.title: Pawar-play post Ajit: Sunetra Pawar for Dy CM? Patel-Bhujbal meet adds to speculation
item.description: With the Deputy Chief Minister’s post vacant after Ajit Pawar’s death, Maharashtra’s power churn has begun. Ajit Pawar’s widow, Sunetra Pawar’s name, is doing the rounds for the Deputy CM post. The political speculation has intensified after senior NCP leaders Praful Patel and Chhagan Bhujbal met her.

item.title: Simple tricks to grow healthy tomato plants in your home garden
item.description: Growing tomato plants at home depends on the right soil, sunlight, watering schedule, fertilizers, and care techniques. Learn how to boost growth, prevent common problems, and enjoy fresh tomatoes—keep reading to get started today.

item.title: Mystery deepens over Sadhvi Prem Baisa’s death in Jodhpur Rajasthan, multiple theories surface
item.description: The mystery involves an alleged Instagram suicide note, persistent online blackmail and trolling, treatment by a local compounder, and suspicious actions by her father.

item.title: “All is good, we are moving on the same page”, says Shashi Tharoor after meeting Rahul, Kharge
item.description: The meeting also followed Tharoor skipping a number of top-level Congress meets, including those in which strategy was discussed for the election this year in his home state of Kerala.

item.title: Citroen hikes prices of Basalt, Aircross and C3 in India
item.description: Citroen has revised prices of its Basalt, Aircross and C3 models in India, with hikes going up to Rs 45,000 depending on the variant. Apart from the price increase, there are no changes to the cars’ features, engines or design.

item.title: Rohit Sharma highlights India’s biggest challenge ahead of T20 World Cup 2026
item.description: In the ongoing T20I series against New Zealand, the Men in Blue have notched up three wins in a total of four matches played till now.
